steps.js: (async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.openDialog({ kind: 'about' }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const text = document.body.textContent || ''; return JSON.stringify({ realStatus: window.__gitgood.store.get().updateState.status, hasUnavailableText: text.includes('Updates unavailable in this build') }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.closeAllDialogs(); window.__gitgood.actions.setUpdateState({ status: 'available', version: '9.9.9', releaseDate: null, notes: 'Fixes a thing.\nSee https://github.com/erwin-wee/gitgood for details.', url: 'https://github.com/erwin-wee/gitgood/releases/tag/v9.9.9', prerelease: false, dismissed: false }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const text = document.body.textContent || ''; return JSON.stringify({ hasBanner: text.includes('GitGood 9.9.9 is available'), hasDownload: text.includes('Download'), hasLater: text.includes('Later') }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.openUpdateNotes(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const d = window.__gitgood.store.get().dialog; const text = document.body.textContent || ''; return JSON.stringify({ dialogKind: d && d.kind, hasNotes: text.includes('Fixes a thing.'), hasLink: text.includes('github.com/erwin-wee/gitgood') }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.closeAllDialogs(); window.__gitgood.actions.setUpdateState({ status: 'available', version: '9.9.9', releaseDate: null, notes: null, url: 'https://x', prerelease: false, dismissed: true }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const text = document.body.textContent || ''; return JSON.stringify({ bannerGone: !text.includes('GitGood 9.9.9 is available') }); })()
